resources.string: Automatically taps “Skip” in the YouTube app and, if you want, mutes the sound during ads. The service sees only YouTube windows and sends no data anywhere.

How to turn it on:
1. Tap the button above.
2. Find AdSkipper under “Downloaded apps” or “Installed services”.
3. Turn the switch on and confirm.

If the switch is greyed out (Android 13+): Settings → Apps → AdSkipper → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
